summary: Blue Gold Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the exchange of $2,042,132 and $778,617 in outstanding indebtedness for newly issued Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 per share, effectively converting debt to equity. Concurrently, the company entered into a new $4,000,000 drawdown facility with the same lender, convertible at $1.00 per share, maturing May 5, 2027. The exchanges were exempt under Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act. A dilutive issuance notice was sent to 3i, LP triggering an anti-dilution adjustment to the conversion price of senior convertible notes. This is a series of capital structure adjustments through debt-to-equity swaps and new convertible financing. No premium or break fee is stated. Watch for dilution impact on existing shareholders and potential conversion exercises.
